author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: বন্ধনীর verb-এর সঠিক রূপ বসাও (Test Paper থেকে সংগৃহীত)।

items.q: It is very alarming to ___ that our youth want to leave. (note)
Our talented young generation ___ reluctant to stay home. (be)
They try to leave as soon as they ___ their education. (finish)
Developed countries ___ them by offering opportunities. (allure)
The country fails to ___ suitable jobs for them. (provide)
We can't help ___ on English nowadays. (rely)
English ___ as a common language for global communication. (use)
items.rule_bn: passive present: is + past participle: is used।

items.q: With a view to ___ views, we learn English. (exchange)
items.rule_bn: 'with a view to'-এর পরে verb+ing: exchanging।

items.q: We have to ___ English for higher study. (learn)
Leaving the country is equal to ___ the motherland. (betray)
